usage: - Refers to a leaf on a plant; very common in everyday gardening and nature talk.
- Often used with plant names or counters when talking about individual leaves, like counting or describing leaf size and shape.
- Can appear in compounds and fixed phrases, so learners should not treat it as only a simple stand-alone word.
- In casual speech, it is neutral and standard; good for both daily conversation and basic biology vocabulary.
